decisions.reason: As an extension of the established offer with its own product page, the firm has visible commitment and can still attribute any weak results to temporary causes, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
Building on the established offer and publicly launched only a year ago, the sunk costs and public justification pressures make withdrawal unlikely.
Although distant from the established range, the public launch and invested resources create commitment, and one year of results can still be explained by temporary factors.
A multi-model product line represents substantial investment and public commitment, and the firm is inclined to persist despite any disappointment in the short term.
